tips.text: Use Bladesurge on low-health minions to reach the enemy, and cast it on a champion marked Unsteady to get it back almost at once.
Land Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge first to mark the enemy Unsteady, then chain Bladesurge on them.
Place the first blade of Flawless Duet past the enemy, then recast so they are caught between the blades and stunned.
Hit minions and champions with your spells to build Ionian Fervor before you trade. Full stacks add bonus damage to your attacks.
Hold Defiant Dance a moment before releasing it for more damage. Time it for incoming crowd control, because it is not interrupted.
Use Vanguard's Edge to trap a champion in its cage; they are slowed when they cross the edge. Fight inside it.
Bladesurge refunds its cooldown if it kills the target. Finish low-health minions or champions to keep dashing.

combos.name: Dash-cast Flawless Duet
combos.when: When you dash onto an enemy and want to stun them as you arrive.
combos.text: Flawless Duet can be cast during the Bladesurge dash. Throw the first blade, dash in, then recast so the stun lands as you arrive.

combos.name: Unsteady Bladesurge reset
combos.when: When chasing a champion with minions or other targets nearby.
combos.text: Flawless Duet marks the enemy as Unsteady. Bladesurge on the marked enemy nearly resets its cooldown, so you can dash again right away.

tips.text: Hit minions with Bladesurge to dash toward the enemy. Low-health minions are best, because a kill refreshes the cooldown.
Land Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge first. Then Bladesurge the unsteady enemy to refresh its cooldown and chain your dashes.
Throw the first blade of Flawless Duet past the enemy, then recast so the blades cross over them. Anyone caught between is stunned.
Start Defiant Dance when you expect damage or a disable. Crowd control can't interrupt it, and holding the charge makes the hit stronger.
Keep Ionian Fervor stacked by hitting champions with your abilities. At full stacks your attacks deal extra magic damage, so trade then.
Aim Vanguard's Edge at a champion. Its blades form a cage that slows anyone who walks through it, so use it to stop an escape or trap a target.
Bladesurge works best when a minion wave is near, because you need targets to dash to. Be careful about diving when the lane is empty.

combos.name: Dash-cast Flawless Duet
combos.when: When you dash onto a target and want a stun without a gap between casts.
combos.text: Flawless Duet can be cast in the middle of the Bladesurge dash. Use it to place the blade or recast it without losing time.

combos.name: Unsteady Bladesurge reset
combos.when: When you want to chain dashes through minions to stay on a champion.
combos.text: The stun marks the champion Unsteady. Bladesurge then almost resets its cooldown on that champion, so you can dash again right away.

combos.name: Ultimate mark Bladesurge
combos.when: When you want to engage a champion and keep Bladesurge available.
combos.text: The Vanguard's Edge barrage marks the champion Unsteady. Bladesurge then hits the mark and comes back almost at once.

tips.text: Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, then dash onto Aatrox. Keep a low-health minion nearby so you can leave if you need to.
Hit Aatrox with Flawless Duet first. It leaves him Unsteady, so Bladesurge comes back almost at once and you can chain dashes.
Start Defiant Dance as Aatrox begins a swing. It cuts the damage you take and crowd control can't interrupt it.
Dodge the edge of The Darkin Blade. Standing in the middle of the swing means you aren't knocked up.
Use Bladesurge to leave when Infernal Chains lands on you, since Infernal Chains pulls you back only if you stay in its area. Dash out of it before the pull.
Use Vanguard's Edge at level 6 to trap Aatrox in the cage when he tries to run, then finish him.
Use Defiant Dance when Briar leaps in with Head Rush or Blood Frenzy; the stun can't interrupt your charge, and you take much less physical damage.
Hit Briar with Flawless Duet to stun her, then Bladesurge onto her to refresh your dash and keep fighting.
Step back while Briar charges Chilling Scream; if it's fully charged and shoves you into a wall, you take heavy damage and get stunned.
Keep minions between you and Briar so Bladesurge always has a target to dash to, and use it to escape her chase.
Briar is forced to attack the nearest enemy during Blood Frenzy; kite away with Bladesurge on minions so she wastes her fast attacks.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, but stay out of Darius's Apprehend range until you are ready to fight.
Trade in short bursts and step away. Darius gets much stronger when he stacks Hemorrhage on you, so don't stand and trade with him.
Use Flawless Duet on Darius, then Bladesurge him. The mark it leaves lets Bladesurge come back almost at once.
Stun Darius with Flawless Duet when he winds up Decimate. He can walk during it but cannot cast Apprehend, so stay out of the axe's edge and hit him.
Charge Defiant Dance when you expect Darius to engage. Crowd control does not interrupt it, and it cuts the damage you take.
Save Vanguard's Edge to trap Darius when he is low. It slows him, so he cannot easily walk out.
Don't stun Fiora with Flawless Duet while Riposte is ready; she can turn it into a stun on you. Wait until she has used it, then commit.
Bait Riposte with a cheap Bladesurge on a minion or a poke, then go in once she has spent it.
Mark Fiora with Flawless Duet, then Bladesurge her to refresh the cooldown and chain your dashes.
Keep minions near you before you trade. Bladesurge needs them to close the gap and to escape her Lunge.
Use Defiant Dance when she is about to strike you; it can't be interrupted and cuts the damage you take.
Hit Gangplank with Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge first; that marks him Unsteady, so Bladesurge hits and comes back almost at once.
Hold Defiant Dance until he tries to trade or detonate a keg; the charge cannot be interrupted and cuts physical damage taken.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, but avoid dashing into a cluster of his kegs; the explosion slows you and hurts.
Stun him with Flawless Duet when he places kegs, so he cannot pop them while you are on him.
Save your stun for after he uses Remove Scurvy; it cleanses disables, so a stun used before it is wasted.
Aim Vanguard's Edge at him when he is low; the cage traps him and slows him heavily.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, but save it to dash onto Garen. Hit him first with Flawless Duet and Bladesurge comes back fast.
Stun Garen with Flawless Duet when he walks up to fight. Then dash in with Bladesurge and trade while he can't move.
Start Defiant Dance just before Garen's Decisive Strike or Judgment lands. Crowd control can't interrupt it, and it cuts the physical damage you take.
Don't dash onto Garen right after he uses Decisive Strike. He gets a burst of Move Speed, and the Silence stops you casting abilities.
Stay out of range while Garen spins with Judgment, since it hurts whoever is closest. Poke him between spins.
Keep Garen from regenerating by chipping him whenever he tries to recover. Perseverance stops working for a while after he takes damage from you.
Stay healthy once you reach level 6 and Garen is hurt, because Demacian Justice deals more damage the lower you are. Retreat before he gets to you.
Hold Defiant Dance for when Jayce commits Thundering Blow or To the Skies!; crowd control cannot interrupt the charge and it cuts the damage you take.
Hit Jayce with Flawless Duet first, then use Bladesurge on him; it refreshes its cooldown so you can chase.
Close in while Jayce is in cannon form and fight him up close, where his long-range poke matters less.
Aim Flawless Duet so the line crosses Jayce; stunning him stops him from escaping with his hammer leap.
Keep minions near you so Bladesurge can reach Jayce, and use it on low-health minions to close distance or dodge his shots.
Don't use Bladesurge on K'Sante minions or into his Ntofo Strikes range carelessly; a pulled and stunned Irelia gets hit hard.
Charge Defiant Dance when you expect Path Maker; crowd control can't interrupt it, and it cuts the damage you take.
Land Flawless Duet on him so he is Unsteady, then Bladesurge to him for a fast cooldown and a quick second dash.
Hit him with abilities to stack Ionian Fervor, then trade while it's full; his Ntofo Strikes slows are weaker when you can dash away.
When he goes All Out, he loses health and resistances; use Vanguard's Edge to trap him and burst him down.
Build Ionian Fervor stacks on minions before you go in; with full stacks your hits deal extra magic damage and you win the trade.
Charge Defiant Dance when Malphite uses Unstoppable Force or Ground Slam; crowd control does not interrupt it and it cuts physical damage.
Hit Malphite with Flawless Duet first, then use Bladesurge on him; it hits the Unsteady mark and comes back almost at once.
Stay spread from Malphite's minions' range when you can; Seismic Shard slows you, so keep a minion or low-health target ready for Bladesurge to escape.
Do not stand in a clump at the end of his Unstoppable Force dash; use Bladesurge to leave when he commits to it.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, then hit Mordekaiser. Don't dash in without a minion or a mark to bring the cooldown back.
Stay out of his Death's Grasp line when you can. Dash sideways with Bladesurge on a minion instead of walking straight at him.
Trade in short bursts and back off once he has hit you three times. After that Darkness Rise makes staying close to him costly.
Hit him with Flawless Duet to stun him and mark him Unsteady. Then Bladesurge onto him and the cooldown comes back for another dash.
When his Indestructible shield is up, hold your damage and wait for it to fade. Hitting into it only wastes your trade.
Use Defiant Dance when you see Death's Grasp or Obliterate coming. It can't be interrupted, and you take less damage while charging.
After Realm of Death takes you into his realm, you are cut off from your team. Plan to fight him with your own tools, not rely on help.
Dash onto Rumble with Bladesurge after he overheats; he cannot cast spells or shield himself, so trade hard then.
Hit Rumble with Flawless Duet first, then Bladesurge to him; the mark it leaves makes Bladesurge ready again fast.
Use Defiant Dance when Rumble's Electro Harpoon or Flamespitter is coming; it cuts magic damage and cannot be interrupted.
Do not stand in the burning trail of The Equalizer; use Bladesurge on a minion or Rumble to leave it quickly.
Stay out of Sion's charging line. A full Decimating Smash stuns for a long time, so dodge it or dash out with Bladesurge.
Use Defiant Dance when Sion starts charging Decimating Smash. Crowd control can't interrupt it and it cuts the damage you take.
Hit Sion with Flawless Duet first. It stuns and makes him Unsteady, so Bladesurge comes back quickly.
Keep minions nearby so Bladesurge always has a target. Stay close to the wave and out of Sion's Roar of the Slayer.
Don't kill Sion carelessly when he is low. Glory in Death brings him back at full health and he hits very fast.
Dash onto minions with Bladesurge to close the gap on Teemo; his Blinding Dart will not make it miss.
Mark Teemo with Flawless Duet, then Bladesurge to him; Bladesurge's cooldown is nearly reset on a marked target.
Look for mushrooms before you walk into brush or a wave; Noxious Trap slows and reveals you. Shoot them with basic attacks.
Use Defiant Dance to soak Teemo's poke while you charge, then release it when he is close. It also reduces magic damage.
Check brush before you push up; an invisible Teemo gets bonus Attack Speed when he breaks stealth.
Dash in with Bladesurge on a minion next to Vayne, then hit her. She is fragile, so short, sharp trades work well.
Hit Vayne with Flawless Duet first to mark her, so Bladesurge comes back almost at once and you can dash again.
Stand away from walls when you fight Vayne, because Condemn pins you for a stun.
Use Defiant Dance when Condemn is about to land. Crowd control does not interrupt the charge, and it cuts the damage you take.
Vanguard's Edge cages Vayne so she cannot Tumble away. Use it at level 6 to finish her off.
Hit Yone with Flawless Duet first, then use Bladesurge on him; the Unsteady mark cuts Bladesurge's cooldown so you can keep chasing.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, then trade with Yone while your Ionian Fervor stacks are full.
Start Defiant Dance just before Yone's knock up or Fate Sealed lands; it can't be interrupted and cuts the damage you take.
Aim Vanguard's Edge at Yone when you want to trap him; the cage slows him if he walks through it.
Hold Defiant Dance for when Ahri throws Charm. It can't be interrupted by crowd control, and the damage reduction softens her burst.
Stay behind minions when Ahri has Charm ready. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of you takes it.
Go in with Bladesurge on a minion to close the gap, then hit Ahri. Kills and Unsteady targets refresh the cooldown, so you can chain dashes.
Stun Ahri with Flawless Duet to mark her Unsteady, then Bladesurge onto her for a cheap cooldown refresh.
Throw the first blade of Flawless Duet past Ahri, so her escape path is covered when the blades meet. She is stunned if she is between them.
Look for the all-in once Ahri has used Spirit Rush. She is much easier to catch and kill without it.
Use Flawless Duet to stun Akali when she jumps in, then follow with Bladesurge. Both can hit her, so a stun and a dash make a strong trade.
Hit Akali with Flawless Duet first, then dash with Bladesurge. It marks her Unsteady, which makes Bladesurge come back almost at once.
Hold Defiant Dance for when Akali commits her burst. Crowd control can't interrupt the charge, and it cuts the damage you take.
Keep minions around you so Bladesurge can chase Akali when she vanishes in smoke, and so you can dash away after a trade.
Use Vanguard's Edge at level 6 to trap Akali when she is low. The cage slows her and stops her from running.
Don't run into Anivia's Crystallize wall. Wait for it to melt, or go around it.
Sidestep Flash Frost. The stun only comes when the ice reaches the end of its range or Anivia detonates it early.
Use Defiant Dance when Anivia casts Frostbite or Flash Frost at you. Stay out of range or you take the full hit.
Hit her with Flawless Duet, then dive in with Bladesurge. The Unsteady mark refreshes Bladesurge so you can chain onto her.
Take a fight at low health with Bladesurge on minions first. Her egg lets her come back, so finish her and hit the egg.
Hit her with Vanguard's Edge to trap her. It slows her inside the cage and stops her from kiting away.
Hit Aurora with Flawless Duet first; it marks her Unsteady, so Bladesurge then comes back almost at once and you can keep chasing.
Throw the first blade of Flawless Duet past Aurora, then recast so the stun catches her as she backs away.
Start Defiant Dance before Aurora's The Weirding or Twofold Hex lands; it cuts the magic damage and crowd control cannot interrupt it.
Don't dash onto Aurora with Bladesurge when she is about to vanish with Across the Veil. Keep it for a minion so you can still reach her afterwards.
If Aurora lands Between Worlds on you, don't walk into its edge; the enemy inside can jump across it and you get slowed.
Use Vanguard's Edge to cage Aurora when she is low; the cage slows her badly and keeps her from hopping away.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, then dash onto Cassiopeia. Keep a low-health minion nearby so you always have a dash target.
Hit Cassiopeia with Flawless Duet and she becomes Unsteady, so Bladesurge on her comes back almost at once. Chain them to stay on her.
Cassiopeia's Miasma grounds you, so you can't dash with Bladesurge while you stand in it. Wait for the clouds to fade, or dash before they land.
Start Defiant Dance just before Petrifying Gaze lands. It can't be interrupted by crowd control and it cuts her magic damage.
Approach Cassiopeia from the side or from behind. Petrifying Gaze only stuns you if you are facing her.
Stand out of the way of the Noxious Blast she aims at you. Dashing through the minion wave makes it hard for her to hit you.
Don't dash onto Fizz with Bladesurge when his Playful is ready; he becomes untargetable and your engage is wasted.
Hit Fizz with Flawless Duet to stun him, then use Bladesurge on the Unsteady mark to dash again at once.
Use Defiant Dance when Fizz commits Urchin Strike or his empowered attack; it can't be interrupted and cuts the damage you take.
Keep minions around so Bladesurge can chase Fizz, but kill low minions first so you can dash away from his Chum the Waters.
Vanguard's Edge cages Fizz and slows him, so he can't easily escape with Playful. Cast it when he is out of position.
Dash onto Malzahar with Bladesurge only when his Void Shift is down; it blocks most of your damage and stuns while it is up.
Hit Malzahar with Flawless Duet first, then use Bladesurge on him; the mark makes Bladesurge come back almost at once.
Stay close to minions so you can chain Bladesurge through them, and avoid waves marked by Malefic Visions that could spread it onto you.
Use Defiant Dance when Call of the Void is about to land; it still charges while you are silenced and cuts damage.
Once you are on Malzahar, push him hard. Vanguard's Edge cages him in, so he cannot walk away from your fight.
Dash onto a minion with Bladesurge, then onto Orianna. Minions give you the reach to close the gap on her.
Hit Orianna with Flawless Duet first. It stuns her and marks her Unsteady, so Bladesurge comes back almost at once.
Use Defiant Dance when you expect her Command: Shockwave. Crowd control can't interrupt the charge, and you take less damage.
Look for her Ball when you dash in. She can only hit what is near it, so stay out of the Ball's area.
Land Vanguard's Edge at level 6 to trap her inside the cage. She takes a lot of damage and is slowed if she tries to leave.
Stay off Ryze's Spell Flux marks when you can. Overload and Rune Prison hit much harder and root you when you are marked.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, then hit Ryze. Marking him with Flawless Duet lets Bladesurge reset.
Hold Defiant Dance until Ryze is about to cast Rune Prison. The charge cannot be interrupted, so the root will not stop it.
Aim Flawless Duet so Ryze is between the two blades. The stun gives you time to reach him and kill him.
Use Vanguard's Edge to trap Ryze when he is hurt. The cage slows him, so he cannot get away.
Dash onto minions with Bladesurge to close the gap, then hit Sylas. Keep the dash ready for when he steps up to trade.
Use Defiant Dance when you see Sylas about to cast Abduct. It can't be interrupted, and it cuts the damage you take.
Stay out of a straight line with Sylas. Abduct is blocked by the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you.
Stun Sylas with Flawless Duet, then dash in with Bladesurge. The stun leaves him Unsteady, so the dash comes back quickly.
Don't go all in when Sylas is low on health. Kingslayer heals him and can turn the fight.
Don't dash onto Twisted Fate with Bladesurge when his Pick a Card is ready. The Gold Card will stun you.
Use Defiant Dance to take his Gold Card stun or Wild Cards; the charge can't be interrupted by crowd control.
Hit him with Flawless Duet to stun him and mark him as Unsteady. Then use Bladesurge on him to reset it and go for the kill.
Watch for Destiny. It reveals you on the map, so he can teleport on you with it.
Hit Viktor with Flawless Duet first, then dash in with Bladesurge. It marks him Unsteady, so Bladesurge comes back almost at once.
Walk up with Defiant Dance charging when you expect his Gravity Field or Hextech Ray. Crowd control can't interrupt it and it cuts the damage you take.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, and don't stand still in his Gravity Field. Staying inside it gets you stunned.
Land the Vanguard's Edge cage on Viktor at level 6. It slows him and stops him from kiting you.
Trade once his Siphon Power is on cooldown. Its shield is what makes your all-in weaker.
Don't throw Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge into Wind Wall; the blades are destroyed and nothing lands. Wait for the wall to fade.
Hit Yasuo with Flawless Duet first, then use Bladesurge on him. It refreshes quickly and lets you keep chaining dashes.
Don't use Flawless Duet into his Steel Tempest knock up; save the stun for when he dashes at you, since the stun leaves him stunned and easy to hit.
Stay out of the way of the whirlwind from Steel Tempest. Being knocked up lets him follow with Last Breath, so sidestep it.
Use Defiant Dance when you expect his burst; crowd control can't interrupt it and it cuts damage taken.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close the gap, then dash onto Yone once he commits his Mortal Steel.
Land Flawless Duet first, then Bladesurge onto Yone; the mark makes Bladesurge come back almost at once.
Start Defiant Dance when Yone's knock up is about to land; crowd control cannot interrupt it and it cuts the damage you take.
Aim Flawless Duet so Yone is between the blades, even if he is in spirit form; it stuns him for a short time.
Trade hard when Yone's Soul Unbound is on cooldown, since he cannot escape or return his damage.
At level 6, Vanguard's Edge traps Yone in a cage, slowing him if he tries to leave. Follow with Bladesurge.
Use Defiant Dance when Zed commits Death Mark on you; crowd control cannot interrupt it, and it cuts the damage you take while he stores his burst.
Hit Zed with Flawless Duet to stun him, then use Bladesurge on him. He is Unsteady, so Bladesurge comes back almost at once.
Use Bladesurge on minions to close in on Zed or to chase him after he swaps away with Living Shadow.
Stay out of his Razor Shuriken lines and trade when it is on cooldown.
